description: Digital partition testbenches: the exhaustive cocotb check of rtl/add8.v (all 2^17 a/b/cin cases) together with the Makefile that drives it and the cold-start script that provisions cocotb and runs it from a clean checkout. The cold start is run, not merely declared: cocotb's Makefile fails on a failing test, so a passing attestation means the exhaustive check really passed on this tree.

pdk.reason: behavioral RTL regression: test_add8.py drives rtl/add8.v through Icarus with no cell library, no SDF and no parasitics, so the cold start consumes no PDK
